title: Mateo Waits for the Paint
youtube_title: Mateo Waits for the Paint | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets good colors stay bright until the right moment arrives.
summary: Mateo paints a moon and a river on his paper lantern, but the paint is still wet when the walk begins to gather. He waits until the colors dry, then joins the calm procession with a lantern that still shows its picture.
